description: Rename a layer, show or hide it, lock it, set whether it prints, its opacity, Layer Options (colour, preview, dim images), knockout group, or move it in the stack

color.description: Highlight colour of the layer's selections and outlines, "#RRGGBB" or "rgb(r,g,b)"

dimPlacedImages.description: Dim placed images on the layer (Dim Images to). Illustrator uses its own percentage; scripts cannot set it

knockout.description: Knockout Group (Transparency panel): whether the layer's objects knock each other out

preview.description: false shows the layer in Outline mode

name: set_layer_properties
title: Set Layer Properties
